query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',id,'conversation_id',conversation_id,'session_id',session_id,'ordinal',ordinal,'revision',revision,'state',state,'provider_conversation_id',provider_conversation_id,'agent_id',agent_id,'text_only',text_only) AS "data!" FROM assistant_conversation_sources WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND conversation_id=$2 AND session_id=$3
